Class GraphList

java.lang.Object
sys.pro.AbstractGraph
sys.pro.GraphList
All Implemented Interfaces:
Graph
public class GraphList extends AbstractGraph
Graph implementation: Adjacency list. Each key is a node, and the corresponding value is the list of its neighbors.
